name: Kadena (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kadena town emblem in blue: a stylised device of a ring with two pointed ears and a swirl.
history: Municipal flag of Kadena, a town in Okinawa Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 1 July 1985; the emblem dates from 17 May 1973.

features.role: Kadena town emblem — a stylised device of a ring with two pointed ears and a swirl
